isolated300s.method: Sequential baseline and staging-only, no competing benchmark process. Same seeds, terrain, rosters, stats and opponent commands.

limits: Frontage is only a geometric proxy, not continuous line coverage.
No flag damage or victory in the 300s fixture on either implementation.
The 30-tile operation link rule was preserved, not independently ablated.
Follower telemetry identifies separation and stationary members, not a proven navigation cause or an error in intended support behavior.
No new corridor-demand, follower-control or forward-screen behavior was introduced.
Exploratory checks were 1Hz; selected correction additionally passed .05s checks for all six full 300s runs.

perStep300sVerification.method: Selected correction; all six scenarios; occupancy, reservations and blocked cells checked after every .05s update. Gameplay snapshots identical to paired run; verification timings not used for CPU comparisons.
